markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (65%)** · Ambiguous: Invasive vs InSitu · Careful review
InSitu (35%) remains in the 90% conformal set alongside Invasive [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 65%, InSitu 35% | Invasive favored; InSitu remains plausible |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% coverage) | Cannot separate Invasive from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 98th percentile [F6] | Passes QC; near OOD tail |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent models match top class |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Invasive (80%) [F5] | Majority Invasive; close InSitu neighbor |

## Tissue evidence
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 5, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · Strongest positive score; 0/20 AI spot-check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4, 8) · context · Above-typical score opposing invasive; 8/20 spot-check [F3] · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 5, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · Second-highest positive score; 3/20 AI spot-check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 1, 5, 9) · context · 75% neoplastic cells (97th percentile) [F7]; nuclear size 0th percentile [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (95% CI excludes 0).
- **Concepts**: Unverified faithfulness (deletion 95% CI includes 0); case leans on Unreliable mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Tumor nests remain duct-confined with intact myoepithelium, matching InSitu (35%) and contrast case BACH_0070 (84% similarity).
- Atypical embedding features (98th OOD percentile) or small segmented nuclei (47 µm²) distort classifier probabilities.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 9, 2, 1**: Highest heatmap risk (87–100%); verify stromal invasion versus in situ carcinoma.
2. **Regions 5, 6, 9**: Confirm mitoses and necrosis directly; both concept detectors scored unreliable on spot-checks.
3. **Regions 4, 3**: Inspect duct boundaries and stroma; consider drafted p63/calponin stains before ER/PR/HER2/Ki-67.
